## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      7 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 14.03.2026 - 02.10.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _mattallsop_, 17.08.2026, 1/5: "I have reported the issue to my bank. This app should be reviewed by Apple for breach of app store rules on billing."
            2. ___Mari__, 19.07.2026, 1/5: "Around two weeks ago, the synchronization with Google Calendar stopped working for all my reservations . I see the confirmation pop-up, but no event is added to my Google Calendar. In addition, I can no longer see any of my friends in upcoming reservations, when they have booked the same reservation. These issues are extremely frustrating and cause a great deal of inconvenience. I already contacted support, but it was not helpful. It seems that even after requesting to speak with a human, an AI bot continues the conversation instead. That’s very disappointing."
            3. _Donotwasteyourtime84_, 30.09.2026, 2/5: "Disappointing free trial experience. My trial was supposed to run through September 30th, but on the 30th itself my credits were already gone when I went to book a class. Earlier, the app glitched while I was trying to book a last minute class and support's only advice was to reinstall the app, which wasn't the issue and just wasted more of my time. I ended up canceling. The idea is great, but the app reliability, support, and unclear trial cutoff made it not worth continuing."
<!--/ir-theme-->
